products.name: Challenge Proxy
products.tagline: Cryptographic challenge protection for any endpoint
products.description: Stop bots and unauthorized clients before they reach your origin. Challenge Proxy issues cryptographically signed challenges that are easy for browsers and native apps to solve, but expensive for attackers to scale.
products.summary: Cryptographic challenge protection that sits in front of any API or web endpoint.
products.keyBenefit: Block abuse without CAPTCHAs or rate-limit gymnastics.
benefits: Eliminate credential stuffing and scraping at the edge
Preserve user experience with no visible friction
Reduce origin load during traffic spikes
Comply with fraud and abuse SLAs
useCases: Protecting high-value login and checkout flows
Preventing ticket scalping and inventory abuse

products.name: Key Service
products.tagline: Sign, verify, and rotate API keys at scale
products.description: Key Service gives your team a single place to issue scoped API keys, verify signatures, rotate secrets, and audit usage across every product surface.
products.summary: Scoped API key lifecycle management with signing, verification, and rotation.
products.keyBenefit: Issue and rotate API keys without touching a database on every request.
features: SDKs for Node.js, Python, Go, and Rust
benefits: Pass security reviews with full audit trails

products.name: Customer Portal
products.tagline: A secure hub for your customers to manage access
products.description: Give customers a branded, self-service portal to manage users, API keys, billing, and support tickets — all gated by your existing identity provider.
products.summary: Branded self-service portal for user, key, and billing management.
products.keyBenefit: Launch a customer-facing portal in days, not quarters.

products.name: Status Page
products.description: Publish a public or private status page that automatically reflects your health checks, incidents, and scheduled maintenance — hosted on your own domain.
products.summary: Public and private status pages with incident management and subscriptions.
products.keyBenefit: Keep customers informed during incidents without building status infrastructure.
features: Synthetic health checks from multiple regions
